resources.string: This application utilizes Accessibility Services to detect when you attempt to exit the 20-minute lockdown window or uninstall the application. It uses this permission to automatically navigate you back to the lockdown screen to enforce your digital wellbeing goals. No personal data is collected, monitored, or transmitted.
